dedupe_keys.name: techno economic data for energy efficiency measures in swiss industry chemical and pharmaceutical cement motor systems excess heat recovery

description: This dataset gives techno-economic data for energy efficiency measures that can be applied in Swiss industrial systems, covering the chemical and pharmaceutical industry, cement, electric motor driven systems and excess heat recovery systems. The Zenodo record says generalised indicators of measure-specific energy savings were developed only for cement, because physical production data, before and after data for implemented measures and statistics on energy use by application were not available for the other branches. It was published in October 2018 by M. Jibran S. Zuberi of the University of Geneva with Martin K. Patel as one Excel workbook of about 1.4 MB ("UNIGE Bottom-up model, public version"), free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Switzerland. Caveats: the workbook supports three papers (International Journal of Energy Research 2018 and Applied Energy 2017 and 2018) and should be read with them; the price and cost year and the number of measures are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives measure costs and savings for bottom-up industrial energy demand models, efficiency cost curves and scenarios where factories cut energy use or recover waste heat for district heating. Related catalogue records include the EIA Manufacturing Energy Consumption Survey and the Hotmaps industrial sites and excess heat data.
